units.note: Opening fragment is a context-less snippet; English preserves it as a fragment. The bracketed [Ptolemy] correctly bridges to the Πτολεμαίου that opens ch. 50.

findings.quote: there also arrived two of the ten commissioners
findings.problem: The Greek names three men: τῶν δέκα Πόπλιος μὲν Λέντλος ἐκ Βαργυλίων, Λεύκιος δὲ Τερέντιος καὶ Πόπλιος Οὐίλλιος ἐκ Θάσου (Lentulus, Terentius, Villius). 'Two' is a number error.
findings.proposed_fix: there also arrived three of the ten commissioners

units.note: Final sentence breaks off at ἀπε- (completed by σιώπησαν in ch. 51); English marks this with [...].
Chapter opens mid-word (ἀπε|σιώπησαν); English 'finished speaking' is fine.
